name: production-direction-signal-walk-forward
description: Walk-forward backtest of the exact classifier logic used in src/signals/direction.py, as a long-only equity proxy strategy (real production system trades options spreads, not the underlying stock).

entry.sizing: 100% of available cash, long-only, no leverage

exit.condition: fixed 3-trading-day hold from entry fill day

benchmark: buy-and-hold same symbol, entered at first bar's open
portfolio_construction: each symbol backtested in isolation with its own starting capital - not combined into one portfolio
